description: Exclude internal and QA website measurements
expression: (http.host in {"myself.md" "www.myself.md"} and (http.cookie eq "myself_internal_traffic=1" or starts_with(http.cookie, "myself_internal_traffic=1;") or ends_with(http.cookie, "; myself_internal_traffic=1") or http.cookie contains "; myself_internal_traffic=1;" or any(http.request.headers["x-myself-qa"][*] eq "1") or http.user_agent contains "HeadlessChrome" or http.request.uri.path eq "/operator/analytics"))
